en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large round tower and adjoining walls of a castle complex. The tower has small windows and a conical roof, and the wall in front looks aged and partly damaged. An ornate arched gate with large wooden doors stands to the right, guarded by two uniformed soldiers. Several civilians walk along the cobbled street outside the walls. On the tower the words "SCHLOSS HART…FEL…" are visible, and there is a commercial signboard on the wall below.
